name: Marksman
description: Builds Aim through ranged direct damage and rewards precision, marks, and tactical shots.

focuses.name: Perfect Shot
focuses.description: Deadeye's empowered Essence ability cannot miss and gains +15% application chance against non-immune targets. If used at 100 Aim, it also gains +15% Effect Potency.

focuses.name: Rain Of Arrows
focuses.description: Deadeye spreads 40% of the empowered Essence effect to up to 2 nearby valid targets. Damage/healing/barrier/resource effects spread at 40% value. Buffs/debuffs/control/summon-related effects spread as 40% duration or strength.

focuses.name: Hunters Patience
focuses.description: Deadeye Mark lasts 5 seconds longer. If you take no Health damage during Deadeye, reduce Deadeye's remaining cooldown by 10 seconds and gain +30 Aim after it ends.

coreMechanic: Gain Aim from ranged direct damage. At 100 Aim, empower the next ranged damage effect.

skillTreeNodes.name: Steady Aim
skillTreeNodes.description: Every 3 seconds without taking Health damage grants +4 additional Aim. Essence effects against your priority target gain +4% Effect Potency while you have 50+ Aim.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Skirmishers Sight
skillTreeNodes.description: Dodging, avoiding, or being missed no longer causes Aim loss and instead grants +5 Aim. After avoiding damage, your next Essence effect against your priority target gains +5% Effect Potency.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.

skillTreeNodes.name: Suppressive Focus
skillTreeNodes.description: Applying a debuff/control effect to your priority target reduces its damage dealt to you by 4% for 5 seconds. Non-hostile Essence effects on an allied priority target grant that ally 4% damage reduction for 5 seconds.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.

skillTreeNodes.name: Focus Fire
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: TargetingConversion. Eligible Area and Cleave Essence abilities concentrate their effect into your priority target. The priority target receives +25% Effect Potency. Secondary targets receive 60% less effect. If the ability is non-hostile, the lowest-Health allied priority target receives the bonus and other allies receive reduced value.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching TargetingConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Huntmaster
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: SummonConversion + TargetingConversion. Controlled allies prioritize your Deadeye target. Their first action against that target gains +10% accuracy/application chance and +8% Effect Potency. When a controlled ally affects your Deadeye target, gain +5 Aim. 5 second internal cooldown. Solo fallback: your own single-target Essence effects against the Deadeye target gain +4% Effect Potency.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching SummonConversion, TargetingConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Surgical Delivery
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: TargetingConversion. Single-target healing, barrier, buff, debuff, and control Essence abilities gain +10% Effect Potency against your priority target. Hostile debuffs/control gain +8% application chance. Ally-targeted buffs gain +10% duration. Direct damage abilities instead ignore 6% defense and resistance against the priority target.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching TargetingConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
